name: board-superpowers
description: Agile scheduling layer for Codex CLI: turn GitHub Projects into the central dispatcher, one session = one PR. Depends on superpowers and gstack.
author: board-superpowers contributors

interface.shortDescription: GitHub-Project-driven scheduling for AI coding sessions
interface.longDescription: board-superpowers turns a kanban projection into the durable dispatcher for role-seated AI coding sessions. v0.8.0 adds the Producer team slice: Role-lane EM dispatch, architect-owned specification delivery, seat-aware autonomy, audited handoffs, and audit schema v3 actor-seat attribution. The original v1 catalog remains 14/14 shipped; the runtime catalog is now 1 entry + 9 molecular + 6 atomic = 16 skills. QA-owned independent delivery verification remains a later slice. Delegates TDD, debugging, review, QA, and security to superpowers and gstack.
